raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 the payments source sends amount corrections in the regular daily delivery by repeating the txn_id with an incremented record_version. silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so 28 version-2 rows sit alongside their version-1 originals, which duplicates keys and double-counts amounts in every gold table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
